killedBy: replayExport saves a replay only when there is one to replay saves nothing when recording is on but no tick has been simulated
why: Saves a well-formed trace of zero ticks when recording is on but the world has not simulated yet, which is the pane's usual state at a title screen. That is the 'misleading empty replay' issue #254 names: the file passes checkTrace and replays into an untouched world, so it reads as a recording of nothing having happened rather than as no recording.
